ammonia.reason: Short 10-day age with limited surface deamination by Geotrichum/Penicillium yeasts.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk with no washed-rind Brevibacterium p-cresol/indole formation.

bitter.reason: Very short ripening limits hydrophobic peptide accumulation from rennet/chymosin proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no blue-derived 2-heptanone/2-nonanone pathway.

browning.reason: Young high-moisture low-proteolysis curd gives limited Maillard reactants on heating.

buttery.reason: High diacetyl 598 mg/kg from Lactococcus citrate metabolism via alpha-acetolactate.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate butyric 126 mg/kg plus isovaleric 80 mg/kg from lipolysis and Leu catabolism.

creaminess.reason: High moisture 54-57% plus 33.6% fat with acid-de mineralized casein giving soft cream.

crumbliness.reason: Lactic demineralized but high-fat high-moisture matrix flows rather than fractures.

firmness.reason: High moisture and lactic acid-softened calcium-phosphate depleted network, unpressed.

floral_honey.reason: Low Phe catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol in short lactic fermentation.

fruity.reason: Very limited esterase-driven ethyl butanoate/hexanoate synthesis in 10-day cheese.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic/caprylic/capric and branched 4-methyloctanoic goaty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: No cooked curd Strecker aldehydes and minimal aged alpine-type propionibacteria activity.

melt.reason: High moisture and demineralized pH 4.45 casein softens and flows moderately on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: White Geotrichum candidum/Penicillium camemberti surface producing 1-octen-3-ol.

oil_off.reason: Young intact fat globules and stable emulsion with little free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Not smoked with no fire-derived guaiacol/syringol phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: High lactic 3074-7790 mg/kg plus acetic 450 mg/kg at pH 4.45 from starter fermentation.

stretch.reason: Acid/mixed curd with no pasta-filata hot-water kneading and no aligned para-casein.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked curd pasteurized milk with low methionine-derived methanethiol/DMS.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose balanced by high lactic acidity and low pH masking sweetness.

umami.reason: Short aging limits casein proteolysis to free glutamate by Lactobacillus peptidases.
